DISC.summary: DISC 2026 (Rome, Nov 9-13 2026): confirmed submission deadline, registration/abstract deadline, rebuttal window, notification date, PC chair, and organizing co-chairs from the official 2026 edition site; record previously had these fields null. DISC 2027 has not yet been announced (no next-edition link, CFP, or dates on the series site); no record created.

sources.evidence: Important Dates: Submission deadline June 1, 2026 (23:59 AoE); Paper registration May 27, 2026; Rebuttal phase July 21-25, 2026; Notification August 5, 2026.
Program Committee Chair listed as Keren Censor-Hillel, Technion, Israel.
Organizing Committee co-chairs listed as Ioannis Chatzigiannakis and Andrea Vitaletti, Sapienza University Italy.
